title: llm-matmeta: hybrid rule-based and LLM metadata extraction for computational materials science
description: llm-matmeta turns the semi-structured output of DFT codes (VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO) and the unstructured text of paper abstracts into validated, machine-readable metadata (JSON and JSON-LD). Exact rule-based parsers produce a trusted draft, a large language model reads condensed evidence into schema-validated JSON, and the two are merged with per-field provenance and an explicit list of conflicts, giving FAIR records with ontology mapping. Local open-weight models are supported.
